name: Super Glue
description: Bonds blocks so they move together.

pages.title: Super Glue
pages.text:
**Super Glue** bonds blocks into one shape so they move together as a contraption, train car, rocket or ship. Click two corners to glue an area.\
\
Blocks that hang on others need none. For ships, Honey Glue does the same job, and one box around the whole ship is enough.

A Schematicannon with **Pre-glue** on glues what it prints.\
\
